notes.title: New Arcade experience added!!!
notes.content:
We have worked hard to present this very important update: A new arcade game added to the main experience

Have lots of fun in a 'quest for diamonds' action game trying to collect as many diamonds as fast as you can on a dangerous plank while avoiding oscillating hanging wood logs. You have to try!

Few games are designed so close to real VR power! (review by the real vr gamers @ Mallorca)
